title: AI service: fewer glibc memory arenas (MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2)
note: On by default (--skip algo-app-malloc leaves it out), effect NOT MEASURED. The AI service (Python, many threads) may keep freed memory in several malloc arenas; one setting limits them to 2. Typical gain is 0 to a few dozen MB; the cost is slightly slower allocation. Meant to be tried on one print and compared with the memory log of algo_app (/var/log/algo_app, 'process mem' lines). An uninstall removes it.
